context.opp: The defenses he faced were easier than average for this season.
context.inj: His team was missing 1.1 expected starters per game on offense; opposing defenses were missing 1.3. (A QB counts as 3.)
context.recent: Recent form uses his last 3 games (weeks 6, 7, 9).
context.short: 1 game cut short by injury counts as partial games here, so missed snaps don't drag down his per-game numbers.

categories.label: Pass Protection
categories.blurb: How well his team protects the QB. Free data doesn't track individual blocks, so these are team numbers while he's on the line.
categories.qualNote: Limited sample: needs 120 offensive snaps to be ranked against other offensive linemen (has 103). Until he plays more, his rating here stays close to his Madden rating.

stats.label: Team ePA per dropback
stats.hint: Expected Points Added: how much each play changed the team's chances of scoring, on average. 0 is average; positive is good for the offense.

stats.label: Team net yards per attempt
stats.hint: Passing yards per dropback, after subtracting yards lost to sacks.

categories.label: Run Blocking
categories.blurb: How well his team runs the ball. Free data doesn't track individual blocks, so these are team numbers while he's on the line.
categories.qualNote: Limited sample: needs 120 offensive snaps to be ranked against other offensive linemen (has 103). Until he plays more, his rating here stays close to his Madden rating.

stats.label: Team stuffed rate
stats.hint: Share of designed runs stopped at or behind the line.

stats.label: Team run success rate
stats.hint: Share of plays that kept the offense 'on schedule' (gained enough yards for the down and distance).

stats.label: Team ePA per designed run
stats.hint: Expected Points Added: how much each play changed the team's chances of scoring, on average. 0 is average; positive is good for the offense.

categories.label: Playing Time
categories.blurb: How much he's on the field, and penalties.
categories.qualNote: Limited sample: needs 120 snaps to be ranked against other offensive linemen (has 103). Until he plays more, his rating here stays close to his Madden rating.

stats.label: Snap share
stats.hint: Share of his team's plays he was on the field for, in games he played.
